_notes.season: A season is Nov 1 to Mar 31, labeled by the year it starts (2025 = Nov 2025 to Mar 2026).
_notes.then_now: Two equal 10-winter windows with no overlap. Change only with Sofia's approval.
_notes.weekly_heat_threshold: An ASSUMPTION the site shows and lets the reader change: heat a city-week if at least this share of its days hit the product's risk rule.
_notes.rare_share_max / severe_tmin_f: ASSUMPTIONS for the 'rare but severe' flag: risk share below rare_share_max in the 'now' window, but at least one day at or below severe_tmin_f.
